name: Mass Communication Internship Programme
benefit:
- **Honorarium****:**An honorarium of ₹15,000/- per month will be paid to each intern.
- **Certificate:**
A certificate will be received upon successful completion of the internship.
- **Facilities:**
The department provides working space, internet facility, and other necessities as deemed fit by the Heads. 
- **Placement:** 
Each selected intern will be posted with a Deputy Secretary, Director, J
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a bonafide student of a recognised University or Institution in India. 1. The applicant should be pursuing a postgraduate course or research programme in Mass Communication, Journalism, Public Relations, MBA (Marketing), or related fields. 1. The applicant may also be a student who has completed a degree/diploma in the above-mentioned courses from a recognised college or university. 1. The applicant must have secured at least 55% marks or equivalent grade in Graduation. 1. The applicant should possess skills and interest relevant to the internship programme, including writing, communication, time management, organisation, traditional and digital marketing, customer service, relationship building, strategic and analytical thinking, and creativity.
